verdicts.missing: The balance rule handles credits that clear the balance. A builder still needs to know whether a credit leaving money due, an open dispute, or a payment plan puts collection on hold.

at 09:00 billing-account local time on calendar days 1, 7 and 14 after the invoice due date. … ends at the first instant on a later local date, exclusively.
verdicts.missing: The rule uses the billing account's clock and allows sends until midnight on any scheduled calendar date. It leaves the recipient's own time zone, business hours and any weekend or holiday adjustments unaddressed.
